verses.text: Ay jun winh winak skuch Naamán, yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Siria. Te xajan winh yuj winh rey chi', te niwan pax yelk'och winh, yujto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'ol t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Te jelan winh t'a owal, palta ayoch jun yab'il lepra t'a winh.
Ay junel, ay juntzanh heb' soldado aj Siria ix b'at elk'al t'a yol yik Israel. Ix yelk'ejb'at jun ix kob'es unin heb'. Ix och ix schekab'ok ix yetb'eyum winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix yalan ix kob'es unin chi' t'a ix b'aj ayoch chekab'ok chi': --Komonok sb'at winh in patrón tik t'a jun winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Samaria, talaj sb'oxi winh yuj jun yab'il tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yal t'a winh sreyal Siria tas ix yal ix kob'es chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Wach' tzach b'ati, swak'b'at junok carta t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj Naamán chi', ix yik'anb'at nanhal swajxakil quintal k'een plata winh yet' nanhal schab'il quintal k'een oro yet' lajunh moj pichul.

Ix yik'anb'at jun carta chi' winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', syalan winh sreyal Siria chi' t'a jun carta chi' icha tik: Ayik ol a chaan in carta tik, ol ojtakejeli to a in tzin chekb'at winh sat yajal heb' in soldado skuchan Naamán tik t'ayach, tzanhtej winh t'a jun lepra ayoch t'ay, xchi winh t'a scarta chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi yilan jun carta chi' winh sreyal Israel chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxaneli to tz'och winh t'a ilk'olal, ix yalan winh: --Tokwal Dios in, ¿tom a in syal wak'an schamel anima, ma swak'anpax sk'inal heb', yuj chi' schekjikot jun winh winak tik t'ayin yik swik'el jun lepra tik t'a winh? Syalelk'ochi to ay tas sna' winh rey chi' t'a in patik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios to ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul winh rey chi', ix yalanb'at winh: --¿Tas yuj ix a nhik'chitejb'at a pichul? Chekkot jun winh chi' t'ayin, ol yilan winh to ay schekab' Dios t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchib'at winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yet' scarruaje yet' schej yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, ix k'och linhan heb' t'a sti' spat winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix schekanb'at winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: Ixik, b'at b'ikel ukelok a b'a t'a ha' Jordán, icha chi' ol aj yel yab'il lepra chi' t'a a niwanil chi', xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Naamán chi', ix b'at winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha wal in naani to ol elta winh in scha'a, ol k'e wal linhan winh slesalwi t'a Jehová sDiosal t'a wichanh, ol yak'anek' sk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch lepra chi' t'ayin, tz'elkan yab'il walani.

¿Tok ek'b'al swach'il junok ha' ay t'a Israel tik t'a yichanh ha' Abana yet' ha' Farfar ay t'a Damasco? ¿Tom max yal b'at in b'ikanel in b'a t'a yol ha' chi', tzin b'oxi? xchi winh. Te aykot yowal winh, ix meltzaj winh.

Palta haxo heb' schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin, q'uinalok ay junok tas ajaltak ix yal winh schekab' Dios t'ayach, ¿tom max a k'anab'ajej? Okxo jun, anhej ix yal winh to tza b'ikel a b'a tzach b'oxikani, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ichato chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi', ukel ix em winh t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios. Ix b'oxikan sniwanil winh chi', icha sniwanil junok unin, te wach' ix ajkani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' ajun yet' chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ix nachajel wuuj to malaj junokxo Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta anhej wal he Diosal a ex israel ex tik. Yuj chi', elokab' t'a a k'ool a chaan in silab' swak' tik t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová, haton ayin schekab', max in chalaj tas tzak' chi', xchi winh. Wach'chom ix ochnhej tean winhaj Naamán chi' t'a winh, palta maj schalaj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Tato icha chi' jun, elok wal t'a a k'ool a chaan wik'b'at chab'ok chejal lum lum yik Israel tik, yujto a in a chekab' in tik, manhxa junokxo Dios b'aj ol wak' in silab', palta to anhej t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Anhej wal jun tzin k'an t'a Jehová to tzin yak' niwank'olal, yujto ayik ol b'at winh in reyal yak'em sb'a t'a stemplo sdiosal skuch Rimón, ol och ketzketz winh t'a in k'ab', hanhejtona' ol in em kuman yet' winh t'a templo chi', yak'okab' niwank'olal Jehová t'a in patik yuj jun chi', xchi winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh ak' pensar, ixik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi'. Palta kenanto sb'at winh,

ix snaan winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi': ¿Tas yuj tonhej ix schab'at winhaj Naamán aj Siria winh wajalil tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix yak'kan winh? Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová to b'at in tzak'wej winh, yalnhej tas ol wik'ek' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Giezi chi'. Haxo ix yilankot winhaj Naamán to wan skot winh t'a spatik, ix emta winh t'a yol scarruaje, ix kot winh scha winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Mantok ay tas ix uji? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Giezi chi' icha tik: Maay, malaj tasi, palta a winh wajalil ix in chekankot wal t'ayach to hato wal sk'och chawanh heb' kelemtak schekab' Dios spetoj t'a tzalkixtak yik Efraín. Yuj chi' sk'an winh t'ayach to tzak' oxeok arroba k'een plata yet' cha mojanhok k'apak pichul yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Naamán chi': --Komonok tz'el t'a a k'ool tza cha wal wakeok arroba k'een plata tik, xchi winh. Yakb'an wan yalan winh chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajem k'een yet' cha moj k'apak pichul chi' t'a yol chab' koxtal, ix yak'ankot chawanh schekab' winh yet' winhaj Giezi chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a tzalan b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yik'an ek' winhaj Giezi tastak yet'nak heb' schekab' winhaj Naamán chi', ix sk'ub'ankanel winh t'a yol spat, ix schekan meltzaj heb' winh.
Elanhchamel ix jawi winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Giezi, ¿b'ajtil ix ach xit'eq'ui? xchi winh. --Malaj b'aj ix in xit'ek' mamin, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ayik ix emta jun winh winak t'a yol scarruaje ix kot winh ul ach scha'a, ¿tokwal maj yil in pixan jun chi' tza na'a? Ha tiknaik, manh smojok ko chaan tumin yet' pichul. Manh smojok pax ko manan te' awb'en te', icha te' olivo yet' te' uwa, nok' kalnel, ma nok' wakax, ma heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab'.

Yuj jun tas ix a k'ulej tik, a tiknaik, a slepra winhaj Naamán chi' ol ochkan t'ayach yet' t'a heb' inhtilal t'a junelnhej, xchi winh. Haxo yik ix spukan sb'a winhaj Giezi yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ayxo lepra t'a winh, sakxonhej yilji sniwanil winh icha k'een cheew.
